title: Benchmarking Qwen3.8 27B quantizations: 4-bit holds up, 1-bit collapses
body: I measured various Qwen3.8 27B quantizations by Unsloth on popular benchmarks: FPQA Diamond, IFBench, and Terminal-Bench-2.1. Q4_K_M is all you need. submitted by /u/pmigdal [link] [comments]
